languageModelTools.name: jexactyl_mod_manager_search
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the current server's Jexactyl mod/plugin catalog.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search the Jexactyl server's existing mod/plugin catalogs. Returns at most 20 results containing only name, creator, short description, and an opaque ref. Use page for subsequent pages. The response includes server-owned compatibility metadata: require exact=true and verify the exact game_version whenever one is reported; for mods also verify the loader, and for plugins verify the platform. gameVersion is the browser's Minecraft version; modLoaderType uses the browser IDs (Forge 1, Cauldron 2, LiteLoader 3, Fabric 4, Quilt 5, NeoForge 6), or use loader by name. sortField/sortOrder and platform use the browser's provider-specific values. Never infer compatibility from a filename, choose the first provider version, override the server-owned filters, or access another server.

source.description: Provider used by the server's browser.

languageModelTools.name: jexactyl_mod_manager_install
languageModelTools.displayName: Install a Jexactyl mod or plugin
languageModelTools.userDescription: Install a selected mod or plugin into the current server.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install one mod/plugin into the current Jexactyl server through its existing authorized browser installer. Search first and use the returned opaque ref when possible; even a user-supplied project/file id is not proof of compatibility. Before calling, verify the search response's server-owned exact=true result and exact game_version whenever reported; for mods also verify loader, and for plugins verify platform. If any required check is missing or mismatched, do not install. Never choose a first/nearby provider version or override the server-owned filters. A user confirmation is required. Returns installed successfully or a stable error_code and message.
